title: StreamAnnouncer Velocity LITE
description: A plugin to announce when a streamer goes live on multiple streaming platforms - Lite version
body:
# 🎬 StreamAnnouncer Lite for Velocity ### **Free Edition — Bridge Your Streaming Community with Your Minecraft Network** > **Minecraft Velocity Proxy Plugin** | **Twitch Live Stream Notifications** | **Automatic Announcements** [![Velocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Velocity-3.3.0+-00AA00?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](https://papermc.io/software/velocity) [![Twitch](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twitch-Supported-9146FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=twitch&logoColor=white)](https://twitch.tv) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1166265613241569381?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=Discord&color=5865F2)](https://discord.com/invite/H2nsh8MNtr) --- *Automatically announce live streams and keep your community engaged — all from within Minecraft, completely free.* > ⚠️ **This is the Lite (free) version of StreamAnnouncer.** > For the full feature set including Kick support, rewards, MySQL & PlaceholderAPI, paid version coming soon!.
--- ## 🌟 Why StreamAnnouncer Lite? Transform your Minecraft server into a streaming-friendly community hub — **for free**. **Make your content creators feel valued.** StreamAnnouncer Lite is the free **Velocity proxy plugin** for integrating **Twitch** with your Minecraft network. When streamers go live on **Twitch**, your entire network knows instantly — with beautiful, clickable notifications and real-time status updates. Everything runs directly on your proxy, no extra plugins needed. **Why choose StreamAnnouncer Lite?** - ✨ **100% free**: Core Twitch notifications at no cost - 🚀 **Velocity-native**: Built specifically for Velocity proxy servers - 🔧 **Highly customizable**: MiniMessage formatting, filters, and per-channel settings - 🪶 **Lightweight**: No backend plugin required — runs entirely on the Velocity proxy - 🔒 **Simple setup**: Get started in minutes with just your Twitch credentials --- ## ⚡ Key Features
### 📢 Smart Announcements - **Instant notifications** when streamers go live - Beautiful **MiniMessage** formatting with gradients & hover text - **Clickable "Watch Now"** buttons with stream title - Filter by **game category** or **title keywords** - Broadcast to **specific servers** or network-wide ![Announcement Preview](https://i.imgur.com/Rel921G.gif)
### 🔗 Player Self-Service - Players link channels with `/setchannel` - **Admin controls** for managing all links - **Transfer links** when usernames change - Full **permission system** for granular control ![Player commands preview](https://i.imgur.com/zK6PIVz.gif)
--- ## 🎮 Platform Support
| Platform | Live Detection | Lite | Premium | |:--------:|:--------------:|:----:|:-------:| | ![Twitch](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twitch-9146FF?style=flat-square&logo=twitch&logoColor=white) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | ![Kick](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kick-53FC18?style=flat-square&logo=kick&logoColor=black) | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | *Kick support and multi-stream viewer links are available in the [Premium version](https://modrinth.com/plugin/streamannouncer).*
--- ## 📊 Lite vs Premium Comparison
| Feature | Lite (Free) | Premium | |:--------|:-----------:|:-------:| | **Twitch** live/offline announcements | ✅ | ✅ | | **Kick** live/offline announcements | ❌ | ✅ | | Smart filters (game & title) | ✅ | ✅ | | Player self-service (`/setchannel`) | ✅ | ✅ | | Admin channel management | ✅ | ✅ | | MiniMessage formatting | ✅ | ✅ | | Auto update checker | ✅ | ✅ | | **Reward automation** (commands on start/stop/during) | ❌ | ✅ | | **Channel-specific commands** | ❌ | ✅ | | **Timed rewards** while streaming | ❌ | ✅ | | **MySQL** cross-server sync | ❌ | ✅ | | **PlaceholderAPI** integration | ❌ | ✅ | | **Multi-stream viewer** links (multiwatch.net) | ❌ | ✅ | | **Plugin messaging bridge** (backend server commands) | ❌ | ✅ | | **HMAC-signed** secure messaging | ❌ | ✅ | | **Streamer join** announcements | ❌ | ✅ |
--- ## 🚀 Quick Start ``` 1. Install on Velocity proxy 2. Add your Twitch API credentials in twitch.yml 3. Add channels: /sav channels add twitch 4. Done! 🎉 ``` **Requirements:** - Velocity 3.3.0+ - Java 17+ - Twitch Developer credentials ([how to get them](https://dev.twitch.tv/console)) > 💡 **Note:** Unlike the premium version, the Lite edition does **not** require the [StreamAnnouncer-Bridge](https://github.com/ax3lt/StreamAnnouncer-public/releases) plugin on your backend servers. Everything runs on the Velocity proxy alone. --- ## 📸 Gallery
*Screenshots coming soon!*
--- ## 🛠️ Configuration Preview All messages use **MiniMessage** with full gradient, hover, and click support: ```yaml # Example: Live stream announcement now_streaming: "%prefix% %channel% is now LIVE! │ %title% ▶ WATCH NOW" # Available placeholders: %channel%, %title%, %url%, %platform%, %player% ``` --- ## 🔌 StreamAnnouncer-Bridge (Premium Only) The premium version supports a companion **[StreamAnnouncer-Bridge](https://github.com/ax3lt/StreamAnnouncer-public/releases)** plugin on your backend Spigot/Paper servers, enabling: - 🖥️ **Command execution from Velocity** — Give items, run reward commands when streamers go live/offline or during streaming. All messages are **HMAC-signed** for security. - 📊 **PlaceholderAPI support** — Display live streaming status in scoreboards, tab lists, chat prefixes, and more. > ⚠️ **The Lite version does not support the Bridge plugin.** Plugin messaging, MySQL sync, backend command execution, and PlaceholderAPI are all **premium-only** features. --- ## ⚡ Upgrade to Premium Want **Kick support**, **automated rewards**, **MySQL sync**, **PlaceholderAPI**, and more? 👉 **Will be published soon!** --- ## 💬 Community & Support
